text:
Here are the best MagSafe (Qi2) car mounts, based on the MountGuys and Gadgeteer reviews. Prices differ between sections of the Gadgeteer article, so check the current price on the product page before you buy.

**Best overall: Anker Prime Qi2 vent mount (25W)**
- It has strong cooling (thermoelectric plus fan), a secure clip, a 60W adapter in the box, and a 2-year warranty.
- MountGuys hands-on tested it. The Gadgeteer lists it at about $70.
- It's the priciest pick, and the clip is narrow, so it may not fit every vent.
- [Buy on Amazon (via MountGuys)](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)

**Best value: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost (15W)**
- It has a built-in fan, works as a vent or dash mount, and its vent clip holds large Pro Max phones.
- The fan is faintly audible, and the Gadgeteer says the car adapter isn't included. ESR's own page doesn't say either way.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99–$35.99.
- ESR's store lists it at $39.99. Code PARTNER18 brings that to about $32.80. Dealectric tested the code on 2026-10-22, and it expires 2026-12-31.
- [Buy via Dealectric (ESR store, with code)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) or [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)
- Dealectric is an affiliate, so it earns a commission on purchases through its link.

**Fastest on a dash: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan (suction, $39.95)**
- It includes a 95W car adapter.
- It needs the fan on to reach 25W, and the base is large.
- [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Other good options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W vent clip ($39.99):** It gives 25W without a fan but needs a 30W+ PD charger, which isn't included. [Amazon](https://pboost.me/a1SMF2dk)
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2 (15W, about $41):** It includes a car charger and has a 2-year warranty. It has no fan, and windshield mounting is restricted in some states. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20)
- **Andobil vacuum suction mount (15W):** It has strong suction, and MountGuys hands-on tested it. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20)
- **EXELIQ cup holder mount (15W):** It's a good choice if you have no vent or dash space. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20)
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 (15W, $59.99):** It fits existing mount arms and has NFC shortcuts, but no cooling. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20)

**Tips**
- Mounts without a fan can throttle toward 7W in hot, sunny cars. A fan is worth it if you live somewhere hot.
- The 25W speeds only work with a Qi2.2-capable phone and a powerful enough car charger.

If you tell me which phone you have and whether you want a vent, dash, or cup holder mount, I can narrow this to one pick.
